extraction.name: TextVQA
extraction.description: A dataset for Visual Question Answering that requires reading and reasoning about text in images
extraction.creator: Amanpreet Singh, Vivek Natarajan, Meet Shah, Yu Jiang, Xinlei Chen, Dhruv Batra, Devi Parikh, Marcus Rohrbach
extraction.publisher: Facebook AI Research, Georgia Institute of Technology
extraction.citeAs: Singh et al. (2019). Towards VQA Models That Can Read. arXiv preprint arXiv:1904.08920.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected using a three-stage pipeline. First, annotators identified images that did not contain text. Then, they collected 1-2 questions for each image that require reading the text in the image to answer. Finally, they collected 10 answers for each question.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The dataset contains some images with no text detected (1.5k images).
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset uses Open Images v3 as the source of images.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators were asked to provide questions that require reading the text in the image to answer. They were also asked to provide 10 answers for each question.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The dataset contains 45,336 questions, of which 37,912 (83.6%) are unique. The average question length is 7.18 words.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset may contain sensitive information such as brand names, locations, and people's names.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset can be used to improve Visual Question Answering models for aiding visually impaired users.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may contain biases towards certain types of questions or answers.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has some limitations, such as the OCR system failing to detect text that is rotated, unstructured, or partially occluded.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for training and testing Visual Question Answering models that require reading and reasoning about text in images.
